investment_strategy: Construct a quality-first, AI-driven equity portfolio with risk-aware sizing. With VIX near 20 and the 10Y at ~4.23%, expect choppy but upward-biased markets over 12–24 months. Overweight resilient mega-cap platforms with strong cash flow and positive AI monetization (Microsoft, Alphabet, Apple) and take measured exposure to high-beta AI enablers (NVIDIA, Micron) benefiting from the GPU/HBM data center super-cycle. Keep allocations conservative to high-volatility names, reflecting policy/regulatory risk and elevated rates. Rebalance quarterly or upon 15–20% position moves; add on pullbacks in semis if fundamentals remain intact.
